gloss: a gift received; a present sent to one

definitions.gloss: a gift received; a present sent to one
definitions.explanation: A gift or present that has been sent or brought to someone. Often implies food gifts or seasonal gifts received from others.

examples.japanese: {到来物|とうらいもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: We shared the sweets that had been sent to us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{到来物|とうらいもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: At year-end, we receive more gifts.

examples.japanese: {到来物|とうらいもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{早速|さっそく}→早速：04173_sassoku⟧⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The fruit we received as a gift was so impressive that I called to thank them right away.

notes:
USAGE:
A slightly formal or old-fashioned word. Common in the context of seasonal gift-giving (⟦お{歳暮|せいぼ}→お歳暮：06126_oseibo⟧, ⟦お{中元|ちゅうげん}→お中元：06125_ochuugen⟧) and neighborly exchanges. The word emphasizes the receiving side — something that has "arrived" (⟦{到来|とうらい}→到来：11788_tourai⟧) as a gift.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {到来物|とうらいもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{裾分|すそわ}け→お裾分け：10602_osusowake⟧ (sharing a received gift with others)
- {到来物|とうらいもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{頂|いただ}く (to receive a gift — humble)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧: gift — general term from the giver's perspective
- {頂|いただ}き⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: something received — humble/polite equivalent
